title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, compiles context and work, lets identical workers self-assign safe opportunities, verifies actual mechanism use, integrates evidence under explicit authority, self-critiques route quality and recursively generates useful next waves with decreasing human coordination.
human_goal: The human normally sends `.` to a bound parent and, only when durable demand justifies it, opens N fresh chats with one identical worker bootstrap. No numbered routing, result transport, durable memory burden, manual batch design or critic-of-last-resort role.
success_conditions: Dot executes from durable state and persists changed frontier.
Planner generates generation N+1 from durable returns/proposals/incidents/critic findings without human batch design.
Identical workers atomically claim distinct work and expose claim/STARTED/context-receipt/checkpoints/RETURN/DONE evidence.
Generic stale/retry/supersession prevents vanished chats from gating progress.
Context Fabric compiles small role/task Working Sets with source-linked receipts.
Steward/Validator reconcile evidence while Human Accepted/Current/Served remain distinct.
Fresh critics trigger from evidence/risk and can change/falsify routes.
At least two automatic worker generations complete and useful durable results per human intervention improves.
Prometeo/Facultad/Alumnos operate as durable concurrent roots.
Parent can disappear mid-loop and a successor continues.
current_frontier: The architecture-coverage phase is complete at 18/18 candidate convergence. The first /wc wave is fully consumed and core allocation/collision/RETURN/post-return behavior has canary evidence, but production /w remains gated. GEN-PROMETEO-ACCEL-01 is ready with eight independent high-compounding unclaimed opportunities. Primary objective is to convert prepared-work parallelism into recursive metabolism: Planner generation N+1, executable Context Fabric/receipts, real throughput/critic metrics and an external event loop, while independently verifying and criticizing the current route.
next_human_action: Open 8 fresh chats and paste the same `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/wc`. Do not number or route them. Afterwards use `.` in the bound parent for integration/replanning.
authority_law: This Chat Object may orchestrate and consume candidate evidence within its scope. Worker/critic returns do not self-promote. Human Accepted, Current, Catalog, Lineage and Served remain separate owner-controlled authorities.
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, roots, queues/claims/runs/returns, integration, verification or frontier must be durable before relying on conversation memory.
